title: Excessive overdraw and particle alpha blending causing GPU fillrate bottlenecks
symptoms: FPS drops severely during dense particle explosions or when UI overlay is open
Overdraw debug view reveals intense white/pink overlapping areas
causes: Multiple overlapping full-screen transparent particle effects
Invisible UI panels retaining active 'Raycast Target' flags

solution.action: Disable 'Raycast Target' on all decorative or non-interactive UI Text and Image elements.
Clamp Max Particles and scale down particle quad dimensions.

prevention: Inspect overdraw visualization in engine viewport before approving VFX.
